title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-03-16
content:
Private Deployments - Weekly Update (week ending 2026-03-15)

Summary
- This week focused on three active customer on-prem/VPC installs (FinBank, MedTech, RetailCo), stabilization of the air-gap installer, and follow-up on security/compliance items blocking production signoffs.
- Primary themes: network/firewall issues, HSM/KMS integration, disk I/O tuning, and install automation flakiness.

Standup highlights (daily concise notes)
- Mon 2026-03-09: Kickoff FinBank validation run; discovered blocked outbound egress to our model catalog S3 endpoints. Ethan raising firewall checklist with customer's network team.
- Tue 2026-03-10: MedTech paused after security asked for HSM attestation docs (FIPS timeline + KMS flow). Zoe preparing HSM integration doc and sequence diagrams.
- Wed 2026-03-11: RetailCo PoC showed degraded tokenization throughput; found kernel io_uring params and ext4 mount options causing throughput drop. Ravi validated improved perf with recommended sysctl changes.
- Thu 2026-03-12: Air-gap installer test failed in CI due to missing cert bundle in minimal image; added fallback to include ca-certificates package for offline bundles.
- Fri 2026-03-13: Weekly sync with Solutions Eng + SRE; agreed to: (a) escalate FinBank firewall policy, (b) schedule HSM demo for MedTech security team, (c) ship hotfix for installer cert handling.

Customer-specific updates
- FinBank (enterprise banking) - Status: blocked by network policy
  - Blocker: customer's outbound allowlist requires explicit IPs for our model catalog endpoints; their change window is next Tue (2026-03-17).
  - Work done: validated deploy works in staging when outbound is allowed; produced a minimal network checklist and sample iptables rules to share.
  - Action owner: Ethan Park -> follow up with customer NOC, provide automated script to validate egress post-change (due 2026-03-17).
  - Risks: until allowlist is updated we cannot run full model pull/validation which delays SLA signoff.

- MedTech (regulated healthcare) - Status: in-progress, security review pending
  - Blocker: security needs proof of HSM/KMS integration (attestation, key rotation, and audit log flow). HSM vendor requires additional integration time.
  - Work done: Zoe compiled HSM docs, example KMS calls, and a short demo plan for 2026-03-18. Began drafting SOC2-friendly audit log snippets.
  - Action owner: Zoe Chen -> deliver demo + docs to customer security (due 2026-03-18). Engage R&D for any driver-level compatibility issues.

- RetailCo (retail analytics) - Status: mostly unblocked, performance tuning applied
  - Blocker: degraded tokenization/throughput on their older NVMe nodes.
  - Work done: Ravi applied sysctl and mount option changes, increased queue_depth, and updated our docs for recommended disk settings. Perf tests show ~22% latency reduction.
  - Action owner: Ravi Patel -> follow up with SRE for longer soak test and include results in runbook (due 2026-03-20).

Operational work / Engineering tasks
- Installer & Air-gap
  - Fixed CA bundle fallback in offline image builder. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/412 (merged to staging).
  - Added extra logging for package installation failures to aid offline debugging.
  - Next: add checksum verification for offline bundles to avoid corruption during customer transfer. Action owner: Sophie Martin (due 2026-03-22).

- Helm chart and operator updates
  - Updated helm chart values for KMS providers to accept HSM vendor-specific fields (PD-1243).
  - Started work on operator reconciliation for staged config changes to reduce manual step during upgrades (PD-1301).
  - Action owner: Mariana Alvarez -> prioritize operator reconciliation tests in e2e pipeline (due 2026-03-23).

- Monitoring and Observability
  - Added temporary dashboards for per-customer ingress/egress metrics and installer success rates. SRE to review retention settings and alert thresholds.
  - Action owner: SRE team (sync scheduled 2026-03-17).

Blockers & Escalations (what needs help)
- Security signoff queue: MedTech requires HSM attestation review. We need a security engineer to join the 2026-03-18 customer demo to answer audit/rotation questions. (Requesting: one security SME)
- Firewall change window: FinBank's allowlist change scheduled for 2026-03-17 — if delayed we risk missing commercial go-live. Product/CS should prepare a contingency communications plan.
- Hardware procurement/customs: one on-prem PoC rack delayed in shipping due to customs in EU; procurement working with partner to expedite. If not resolved by 2026-03-21, escalate to ops leadership.

Meeting notes (Weekly sync 2026-03-13)
- Attendees: Mariana, Ethan, Zoe, Ravi, Sophie, Gregg (Solutions Eng), Priya (SRE)
- Key decisions:
  1) Add an explicit network troubleshooting script to the onboarding checklist (owner: Ethan).
  2) HSM demo scheduled 2026-03-18; security SME to be added (owner: Zoe + security).
  3) Post-install soak tests to be standardized and added to runbook (owner: Ravi).
- Open questions:
  - Do we want to add a managed proxy alternative for customers who cannot open outbound to S3? (needs product input).
  - Should we charge for on-prem air-gap support beyond standard onboarding SLA? (commercial/CS).

Action items (owners + due dates)
- Ethan: provide and test outbound egress validation script for FinBank (due 2026-03-17).
- Zoe: deliver HSM integration demo and docs to MedTech security (due 2026-03-18).
- Ravi: run 72-hour disk soak and publish results to runbook (due 2026-03-20).
- Sophie: implement checksum verification for offline bundles and include in release notes (due 2026-03-22).
- Mariana: add operator reconciliation e2e tests to pipeline (due 2026-03-23).
- Product/CS: draft contingency customer comms for FinBank if change window slips (due 2026-03-17).

Risks & Mitigations
- Risk: prolonged network/blocking window at FinBank delays revenue recognition. Mitigation: offer temporary staged deploy with reduced functionality (no model pull) to validate infra while waiting for allowlist.
- Risk: HSM vendor integration takes longer than expected. Mitigation: provide documented fallback using cloud-KMS with documented controls for short-term signoff (requires security approval).

Notes to self / TODOs
- Capture a short playbook for common firewall errors (curl tests, tcpdump snippets, traceroute, expected AWS S3 endpoints).
- Coordinate with legal on whether we can accept vendor-signed HSM attestations vs internal tooling proof (for MedTech).
- Prep a short demo video of air-gap installer happy path to reduce first-contact friction.

Attachments / references
- Onprem install checklist (Confluence): CONFLUENCE:PD-Onprem-Install-Checklist
- Jira tickets: PD-1243 (helm/kms fields), PD-1301 (operator reconciliation)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/412

Next weekly focus (week of 2026-03-16)
- Finish HSM demo and secure security signoff for MedTech.
- Validate FinBank network change after 2026-03-17 and run full model pull + validation.
- Complete air-gap bundle checksum and release hotfix.
- Harden installer logs and add a troubleshooting page to docs.

End of weekly update.
